name: Birch Thicket
description: A dense grove of paper birches. Ideal for woodcutting, but watch out for territorial wood goblins.
visualTheme: Dense white birch trunks stretching to a canopy of gold-green leaves, with birds chirping and rustling bushes.

history.createdWhy: Grew rapidly after the great forest fire of the previous century.
history.majorEvents: Host to the Wood Goblin Skirmish of Level 5.
history.whyExists: Serves as the main timber harvesting grounds for Oakhaven Hamlet.
history.currentConflicts: Wood Goblins have set up camp traps to raid loggers.
